_notes: 2026-06-29: Chris (Watson) asked to send unanswered incoming calls to voicemail after 20s. The ring-before-voicemail timeout already existed (queues.ring_timeout, default 30s) but had no UI control AND was being silently reset to 30 on every queue save (the admin update route omitted ring_timeout while db.update_queue defaults missing keys via data.get('ring_timeout', 30)). Two commits: 9295f70 added the field to the admin create/edit forms and wired it through both routes (fixes the silent reset); 38f816b added a least-privilege manager path (db.set_queue_ring_timeout single-column setter + @manager_required /admin/queue/<id>/ring-timeout route re-checking is_queue_manager + control on /queues) so Chris can set it without full admin. Derek then assigned Chris as Manager + queue manager via the deployed UI. NOTE: ring timeout only governs how long phones ring; after it expires the call goes to the queue's no-answer action (defaults to AI receptionist, NOT plain voicemail) — true plain-voicemail-after-20s needs the no-answer action changed on the Call Flows page (admin-only, NOT done).
